cognitive_contract.label: Apply / multi-stage procedural machinery (National/International Olympiad)
cognitive_contract.decisive_act: Executing complex multi-stage procedural machinery, algorithmic pipelines, and Diophantine ring calculations to evaluate protected numerical or symbolic quantity W.
cognitive_contract.band_protected_work: Require learner to execute complete non-linear curvature quadratic solving, Pell ring exponentiation, or generating function partition reduction without intermediate calculations.
cognitive_contract.support_posture: Activate the starting equations or recurrence setup without executing the multi-stage procedural evaluation.

slots.X: executing Descartes' Circle Theorem on a mutually tangent circle triplet to evaluate the radius of the externally tangent fourth circle
slots.Y: three mutually externally tangent circles with radii 1, 2, 3
slots.Z: Descartes' curvature relation (k1 + k2 + k3 + k4)^2 = 2(k1^2 + k2^2 + k3^2 + k4^2) with k4 = k1 + k2 + k3 + 2*sqrt(k1*k2 + k2*k3 + k3*k1)
slots.wrong_idea: taking the negative square root branch corresponding to the circumscribing outer circle (radius 6) instead of the smaller externally tangent circle, or inverting curvatures incorrectly
slots.replacement_rule: external tangency to all three smaller circles requires the positive root for maximum curvature k4 = 11/6 + 2 = 23/6, yielding r4 = 6/23
slots.visual_job: render Apollonian circle configuration showing mutually tangent circles with radii 1, 2, 3 and the tightly packed inner tangent circle; avoid unmounted SVGs
slots.check_job: independent verification: verify coordinates of circle centers: C1=(0, 1), C2=(0, -2) tangent at (0, 0), find C3 by Apollonian distance equations and verify C4 distance to all three matches r4 = 6/23. Verified.

core2_custody.stem_requirement: Exact formulation of an international Olympiad multi-stage procedural application demand
core2_custody.hint_ladder_requirement: H1 activates the algebraic/curvature framework; H2 provides intermediate curvature sum or fundamental solution; preserves W
core2_custody.solution_requirement: Locked pre-commit; complete formal step-by-step calculation evaluating W
core2_custody.distractor_requirement: Every distractor explained with specific student procedural errors or erroneous branch selections

core1a_declarative.anti_leak_rule: Strict prohibition on leaking Core 2 exact parameters or textual answer in Core 1A text

core1b_reconstruction.model_alternation: Reconstruction must use an alternative analytical pathway (e.g. Apollonian coordinate systems or generating series)

core2a_supported_practice.transfer_obligation: Near-transfer item applying the procedural machinery to a related configuration

core2b_transfer_assessment.transfer_obligation: Far-transfer item applying the technique to an Olympiad competition problem
